newsitem.title: USA: Some 62,000 MassElectric customers without power.
newsitem.headline: Some 62,000 MassElectric customers without power.

text.p: MassElectric, a unit of New England Electric System, reportedly had 62,000 customers still without power Monday in the wake of snow, said a spokesman for Massachusetts Emergency Management Agency.

"Most of the problems are in the central part of the state between Worcester and up through the Merrimack Valley and out into the western part of the state," said agency chief of operations Jerry Meister.

A furious storm that dumped up to 18 inches of snow in parts of Massachusetts and New Hampshire Saturday night killed power to almost half a million customers of various utilities throughout New England and caused two dozen school districts to cancel classes for Monday.
Roadways were clear of the heavy wet snow in Massachusetts Monday, Meister said.
